create_skip_multi_rnn_cell: create a SkipMultiRNNCell composed of multiple RNNCells with skip connections between layers
build_rnn_cell_tuple_states: build a SkipMultiRNNCell with state_is_tuple=True to return per-layer state tuples
build_rnn_cell_concatenated_states: build a SkipMultiRNNCell with state_is_tuple=False to concatenate all layer states along the column axis
run_skip_multi_rnn_cell: run a SkipMultiRNNCell on inputs with initial state to get output and new states with skip connections
review_skip_multi_rnn_cell_properties: review the state_size and output_size properties of SkipMultiRNNCell for multi-layer RNN configurations
